description: We are a software development team from Dushanbe building VITA, a health self-monitoring system for astronauts on long space missions. The app tracks vital signs, sleep, exercise, radiation dose, mood and alertness, compares them with each astronaut's own preflight baseline, and tells the crew what to do next, fully on board. Super Intelligence (SI) tools were used to assist with code and text; all design decisions and the final review were made by the team.
